failureRootCause: Every failure traces to mock documents lacking ownerId while the production service functions now enforce owner-scoped guards (doc.data()?.ownerId !== ownerId) or owner-scoped queries (.where('ownerId','==',ownerId)). The tests supply 'Test Key' as ownerId to service calls but the mock documents never carry that field.

indexHandlerPattern: Every user-facing handler calls identityOr401(req,res) first. On success it receives a RequestIdentity with a non-null ownerId. On failure it writes 401 and returns null (handler aborts). The ownerId is then passed as identity.ownerId to every service function call. 32 handlers verified, all follow this pattern.
missingIdentityGuards: None found. identityOr401 is the single auth gate at the handler boundary. migrateDecksHandler and migrateReviewEventsHandler additionally check identity.isOperator (403 if false).
